housing: Aberdeen's rentals are mostly granite tenement flats and terraces, with newer estates on the edge of the city.

localRules.text: All private landlords in Scotland must register with the council for the area where they rent out a home.

In Scotland the landlord must lodge the deposit with an approved scheme (SafeDeposits Scotland, Letting Protection Service Scotland or MyDeposits Scotland) within 30 working days of the tenancy starting.

tenantHelp.name: mygov.scot
tenantHelp.what: Scottish Government guidance on renting and deposits

tenantHelp.name: First-tier Tribunal for Scotland (Housing and Property Chamber)
tenantHelp.what: decides private renting disputes, including unprotected deposits

climate: Test the heating and check windows for draughts; Aberdeen winters are cold and long.
fact: Much of central Aberdeen is built from grey granite, which earned it the name the Granite City.
